faqs.question: I see horizontal or vertical lines in my printout. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Perform a nozzle check from the printer's control panel or the Epson printer driver, then do one of the following:
If there are gaps in the nozzle check pattern, clean the print head nozzles.
If there are no gaps in the nozzle check pattern, try the solutions below.
Horizontal Banding
Increase the print resolution.
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Select an alternate paper profile for ink coverage.
Select the correct paper type in the printer driver.
Adjust the paper feed
Vertical Banding
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Align the print head.

faqs.question: The colors on my printouts do not match the colors on my computer monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following recommended color correction methods:
Use ICC profiles during the color management process.
Ensure that you are using the correct output profile for your loaded media.
Note:
You may need to create a custom ICC profile for the best results.
Ensure that your monitor is calibrated and is displaying accurate color.
Compare the print result with the image on your computer screen in a well-lit environment. Since monitors and printers produce colors differently, printed colors and screen colors do not always look the same.
If the recommendations above do not help, contact Epson support.
The color management process is complex. We can assist you with the proper assignment of settings; however, we cannot assist you with creating a custom color profile.

faqs.question: I see the message Communication Error when I use a USB connection. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Delete all print jobs in the print queue.
Turn the printer off.
Note:
Make sure the USB cable is connected correctly.
Restart your computer. When the desktop appears, turn your printer on and follow the on-screen instructions.
Note:
If the problem continues, turn the printer off again and delete the printer in the list of printers. Then disconnect the USB cable from the printer and connect it again.

faqs.question: A connection error appears after I installed a new or updated printer driver on my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Uninstall the Epson printer driver. To uninstall the printer driver, go to the                 Downloads tab for your product, select
Uninstaller v1.3.1
, and follow the on-screen                 instructions to complete the uninstall.
Install Epson printer driver ver. 10.85. This driver version has limited print                 options, but it should resolve this issue.
Note:
An updated printer driver will be available later to resolve the                     problem.
Tip:
If your printer stops printing after                 entering sleep mode, you need to wake the printer up to print again.

faqs.question: Can I print photographic output with my product?
faqs.answer:
Although the printer is capable of delivering quality prints, it is designed for engineering, CAD, and GIS markets. The SureColor T3270 Screen Print Edition also is designed for screen printing.
For information about our Epson Professional Imaging printers, please visit the Epson Store.

faqs.question: Does my product automatically switch to the correct black ink cartridge (Matte Black or Photo Black) when I select the media type in my product software?
faqs.answer: Yes, the printer will automatically switch to the correct black ink.

faqs.question: What is the smallest ink drop size my product will produce?
faqs.answer: The smallest drop is 3.5 picoliters.

faqs.question: Are different-sized ink cartridges available?
faqs.answer: The printer supports three sizes of Epson Ultrachrome XD ink: 110 ml, 350 ml, or 700 ml. You can mix-and-match different sizes for each color.

faqs.question: How can I prevent the Epson UltraChrome ink on the Epson Screen Positive Film from sticking to the emulsion layer of the screen?
faqs.answer:
This may happen if moisture collects on the film or the emulsion. Try the following:
Allow more time for the emulsion to dry.
Expose the screen positive film in an environment where the relative humidity is no higher than 55%. Use a dehumidifier to lower the humidity in the room, or move the film to a less humid area.
Use an emulsion exposure calculator to determine the appropriate exposure time. The screen may have been exposed for too long.

faqs.question: Why does it take a long time for Epson UltraChrome ink to dry on Epson Screen Positive Film?
faqs.answer: In high humidity environments, Epson UltraChrome ink takes longer to dry on Epson Screen             Positive Film. For optimal results, print in a controlled environment where the relative             humidity is no higher than 55%.

faqs.question: Is the Dual-Roll feature an option?
faqs.answer:
The Dual-Roll feature is only available on the SureColor T5270D or SureColor T7270D models and is not separately available.
Note:
The SureColor T3270 does not have a version with a Dual-Roll feature.

faqs.question: Does my product support roll and cut sheet media?
faqs.answer:
Yes, the printer supports both roll media and cut sheet media.
Note:
Full borderless print jobs are supported on select roll media widths.

faqs.question: Does my product support media besides Epson Screen Positive Film?
faqs.answer:
Yes, the printer supports media for non-screen print jobs. See
Supported Media
.

faqs.question: Which media do I use for screen printing?
faqs.answer: You can use Epson Screen Positive Film, which is included with the printer.

faqs.question: Does my product stand come with my product?
faqs.answer: Yes. The printer comes with a printer stand and a print basket.

faqs.question: What is the main purpose of the Internal Print Server?
faqs.answer:
The print server allows you to save print jobs and re-print them from the control panel.
Note:
You cannot use a print server from a different printer (such as the SureColor T3000, T5000, or T7000 models) with the SureColor T3270, T5270, T5270D, T7270, or T7270D models.

faqs.question: Do all T-Series products support screen printing?
faqs.answer:
The Epson SureColor Screen Print Editions were designed to give screen printers a complete solution to producing screen positive film. For the most reliable and consistent results, it's recommended that screen printers purchase and use the Screen Print Edition printers; however, the standard SureColor T5270/T5270D and SureColor T7270/T7270D will produce great results when used with Epson Screen Positive Film in conjunction with a third-party RIP software (AccuRIP Black Pearl).
